powScope.note: pow records kept only where V8's value does not depend on the host libm (see jsMath.mjs powClass)

note: Math.atan2/exp/tan/acos/asin/atan/tanh are V8 src/base/ieee754.cc (fdlibm), identical on every OS. Math.pow is V8 src/numbers/ieee754.cc math::pow: ECMAScript special cases, y == 2 -> x * x, y == 0.5 -> sqrt(x + 0), then std::pow, i.e. the C runtime of the platform below (Windows: the UCRT).
